Shreyas Iyer's captaincy under scrutiny after T20I losses

Following recent T20I defeats, including a significant loss to England, Indian cricketer Shreyas Iyer's captaincy is facing scrutiny. His sister has publicly backed him, expressing confidence in his future leadership. India's recent performance includes one win and ten losses in twelve matches under his captaincy, with the team needing to win upcoming games.
